post.summary: AG-UI chat transport for course Q&A (consumed by `useChat`).
post.description:
Access, budget and the thread/user message are settled before the stream
starts, so they fail as normal HTTP errors; the model call and the
answer's persistence happen inside the stream, where a failure is a
`RUN_ERROR` event. A retried `client_turn_id` replays the stored answer.

409.description: Turn id reused or still in progress

200.description: The caller's threads, newest activity first

404.description: Not the caller's thread in this course
Not the caller's thread in this course

post.summary: The learner records a score; 70 or more passes (and lifts a gate).

403.description: Not the learner of this session

get.summary: A learner's sessions: their own, or anyone's with `platform:read`.

post.summary: Abort a queued or running run; a finished one is returned unchanged.
Follow a run as AG-UI events (`event: run`).
post.description:
`RUN_STARTED`, one `CUSTOM {name: <event_type>, value: {state, message,
payload}}` per run event, then `RUN_FINISHED` or `RUN_ERROR {code}`.
`id:` is the Redis stream id to resume from with `Last-Event-ID`.

429.description: Too many open streams for this user

post.summary: Answer inline; the body is the `study_companion` artifact.

get.summary: The newest analysis of a submission; `null` when none exists.
Platform token usage against the monthly budget.
Alias of `/ai/usage` kept for the legacy client.
Platform-wide overview (`analytics:read:platform` / `:all`).

delete.summary: Delete an item; siblings renumber.

patch.summary:
Partial item update. Body/max-score changes are refused (409) once a
published assessment has graded submissions.

post.summary: Run code against an item's visible tests (or one custom input).
post.description:
Does not affect any grade — hidden tests only run at submit. Needs
submit access to the assessment (authors may preview and see hidden
data). With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry with the same source, input
and language replays the finished run (200); a different payload under
the same key is 409. Limited to 20 runs per minute per user.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused for a different run

422.description: Blank source, wrong item kind, or language not allowed

503.description: Code runner unavailable (run recorded as degraded)

post.summary: Create an assessment with its backing activity (appended to the chapter).
post.description:
Requires `assessment:author` on the course (platform scope or course
creator with own scope). Code challenges start with one default code
item.

get.summary:
Full assessment with items and policy. Authors always; learners only
once published (404 otherwise — no existence leak).

patch.summary:
Title/description/weight/grading type. Archived assessments are
read-only; a published one with submissions must be unpublished first.

get.summary: Who may take the assessment (authors only).

put.summary:
Replace the access policy. Restricted lists are validated against the
course (users need course access, groups must be linked); switching to
all-course-learners wipes both lists.

get.summary: What the caller may do with this assessment right now.
get.description:
The effective policy (overrides applied) and any reasons an attempt is
blocked. Requires course access, the allowlist when restricted, and
`assessment:submit:assigned` (authors preview freely).

get.summary: Lifecycle transitions and override changes, newest first.

post.summary: Extend the due date for selected learners.
post.description:

422.description: Unknown learners or a past date

post.summary:
Deep-copy as a new draft (policy + items; not access lists or
per-student overrides), appended to the same or a given chapter of the
same course.

get.summary: Per-item response counts, average score, correctness and discrimination.

post.summary: Append an item (kind must suit the assessment; at most 200 items).
Reorder items; returns the full list in the new order.
Lifecycle transition.
post.description:
Allowed: draft→scheduled/published/archived,
scheduled→draft/published/archived, published→draft/archived,
archived→draft. Scheduling and publishing require readiness (422 with
the issues as field errors); scheduling needs a future time.

One entry per language the item allows; `missing_solution` when no

get.summary: Submitted work awaiting or holding a grade, newest first.
get.description:
Needs `assessment:grade` on the course. `status=needs_grading` is the
pending queue. Keyset-paged: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

patch.summary: Merge preferences (`null` removes a key).

post.summary: Touch a streak for today (same day keeps, next day extends, a gap resets).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.

Readiness: dependencies are reachable (Postgres; Redis/RustFS/Zitadel probes
join as their clients land).
Every certificate the caller holds.

The platform singleton. Intentionally public: the frontend bootstraps
navigation, auth pages, and landing content from it before any session
exists.

Update platform settings (requires `platform:update:platform` — admins).
Branding changes claim finalized `platform-logo` / `platform-thumbnail`

get.summary:
Platform search over courses, collections, and people. Anonymous callers
see public content only and no people section.
One attempt the caller owns (404 for anyone else's).

patch.summary: Merge answers into the open draft.
patch.description:
Requires `If-Match` with the draft_version you loaded; 409 carries
`{expected, actual}` when someone (another tab) saved in between.
Throttled to one save per 5 seconds per draft (429).

409.description: Stale draft_version or not a draft

get.summary: Grading events for one submission as `text/event-stream`.
get.description:
Event names: `connected`, `grade.published`, `submission.returned`,
`deadline.extended`. `data` is the stored event
(`{event_id, event, submission_id, payload, sent_at}`); `id` is the
stream id to send back as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect.

429.description: Too many open streams for this user

get.summary: Released item feedback on one of the caller's own submissions.

patch.summary: Save, publish or return a grade.
patch.description:
Requires `If-Match: "<version>"`; a mismatch is 412 with
`{expected, actual}`. Item scores merge into the breakdown, the raw
score is given or computed from them, and the late penalty recorded at
submit applies on top. Each save appends to the grading history.

get.summary: The append-only grading ledger of a submission, newest first.
A submission with answers, breakdown, versions and feedback (graders).

post.summary: Submit the draft for grading.
post.description:
Optionally applies a last answer patch. `If-Match` is honoured when
present. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry with the same body replays
the original response for 24h; the same key with a different body is
422. Limited to 3 submits per 10 seconds per learner.

403.description: Attempt cap, time limit, or past due

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

post.summary: Report one anti-cheat event on the open draft.
post.description:
Returns the server-side count and whether submitting now zeroes the
attempt (a detector is on and the threshold is reached).

get.summary:
The caller's trail: one run per course, one step per activity marked
done. Anonymous callers get an empty trail.

post.summary:

get.summary: Redirect to a short-lived presigned download URL.

post.summary: Finalize after the PUT: verifies the object exists and is within policy.

get.summary: Ranked work items for the caller.
get.description:
`role=learner` (default) lists the caller's own open activities; `role=teacher` lists submissions to grade
or release across the courses the caller created or co-authors. Sorted
by priority, then due/created time, then id; paged by an opaque cursor.

effective_user_count.description: Distinct people reachable through both lists.

content.description: Editor content (dynamic pages) or type-specific payload.

ActivityDetail.description: Full activity view with the heavy jsonb columns.

AdminAwardRequest.description: Platform managers grant XP to a user.

oneOf.description: The creating teacher; `None` groups courses without a creator.

AdminRun.description: One run in the operations view (legacy `AIOperationRunRead`).

context.description: The allow-listed part of the run metadata.

stuck.description: Queued or running for over ten minutes.

effective.description: The whole `AB__AI__*` section with secrets redacted.

AdminUser.description: Admin listing row (includes email + status — platform:read gated).

AiRunStatus.description:
Run lifecycle (ARCHITECTURE §12): `queued → running → {succeeded,
failed, aborted}`. The legacy names were finished/error.

AiThreadRole.description: The caller's role in an AI thread (legacy `AIThreadRole`).

AssessmentKind.description:
What the assessment is; decides the backing activity type and which
item kinds are allowed.

status.description: Submission status of the latest attempt (`pending`, `graded`, …).

why_now.description: Stable code explaining the strongest signal.

Attempt.description:
One attempt. For its owner, `final_score`, `feedback` and
`rubric_scores` are `null` until the grade is published or the work
returned.

AttemptState.description: What the learner may do right now (flat flags for the client).

can_continue.description: An open draft exists and may still be worked on.

can_start.description: No open draft and nothing blocks a new attempt.

revision_requested.description: The latest attempt was returned for revision; the cap is lifted.

CaseResult.description:
One test's outcome. Hidden tests lose `stdin`/`expected`/`actual`/
`stdout`/`stderr` for non-authors (see [`CodeRun::masked`]).

actual.description: `stdout` with surrounding whitespace trimmed (what was compared).

verify_code.description: Public verification code; the client links `/certificates/{code}/verify`.
Public verification code of the issued certificate.

config.description: The client's PDF designer document (opaque to the server).

index.description: 0-based position among chapters that have published activities.

starter_code.description: Keyed by language id as a string (legacy shape).

CodeRun.description:
A code run and its per-test results. Learners never see hidden tests'
input, expected output, or their program's output on them.

replayed.description: Served from an earlier run under the same `Idempotency-Key`.

score.description: Weighted pass share 0..100; `null` for custom-input runs.

courses.description: Member courses visible to the caller, in collection order.

CollectionHit.description: Collections in search results are light — no embedded courses.

ConfigPatch.description: The configuration block; every field optional on create and patch.

stale.description: The course content changed since this analysis (latest view only).

CourseUpdate.description: One announcement in the course changelog feed.

activity_type.description: One of the closed activity-type set (e.g. `video`, `exam`).

chapter_id.description: The activity is appended to this chapter.

oneOf.description: Omit to start from the kind's preset.

file_name.description: Original client-side file name, for display.

upload_id.description: A finalized upload (purpose must match the block type).

courses.description: Course membership; every course must be readable by the caller.

content.description: HTML or text; must contain visible text.

CreateInterventionRequest.description:
Log a teacher action for an at-risk learner. `status` defaults to
`completed` (legacy).

body.description: Tagged on `kind`; must be a kind the assessment allows.

purpose.description:
One of: avatar, course-thumbnail, block-image, block-pdf, block-video,
file-submission.

put_url.description: PUT the file bytes here (presigned; valid for ~15 minutes).

CurriculumChapter.description: A chapter with its activities, in curriculum order.

DisabledReason.description:
Why a learner cannot act right now (legacy `disabled_action_reasons`;
the attempt/timer-based ones arrive with submissions in P4).

replies.description:
Embedded when the list was asked for `include_replies` (replies
carry an empty list — one level only).

DiscussionAuthor.description:
The post's author — no email (unlike the legacy `UserRead`); `null`
once the account is gone.

DraftRequest.description: The draft's complete file list (replaces what was attached before).

oneOf.description: Target chapter in the same course; defaults to the source's chapter.

override_applied.description: An unexpired per-student override shaped this.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, closed set of machine-readable error codes.

editable.description: Flags come from the environment; there is no runtime toggle.

FieldError.description:
A single field-level validation failure. `code` is a stable machine key the
frontend translates (e.g. `required`, `too-long`); `message` is English.

rubric_scores.description: Omit to keep the stored rubric scores.

FindingReviewAction.description: Teacher review verdict on one course-analysis finding.

label.description: Stable code (`enrolled`, `active_7d`, `completed`) or a chapter name.

rewards.description: Source → XP overrides; unknown sources are ignored.

final_score.description:
Raw 0..100 before the late penalty; omitted = computed from item
scores (earned / possible × 100).

GradebookPage.description: Latest submitted attempt per (learner, assessment), keyset-paged.

IssuedCertificate.description: A certificate with its template and course.

discrimination_index.description: Classic (top 27% − bottom 27%) / n, from six attempts up.

ItemAnswer.description: Internally tagged on `kind`, mirroring the item body kinds.

ItemBody.description: Internally tagged on `kind` — the wire and storage shape.

LanguageInfo.description: A Judge0 language the platform allows.

scheduled_at_unix.description: Required when `to` is `scheduled`; must be in the future.

LoginRequest.description: Password login. No `Debug` derive — the password must never format.

MoveActivityRequest.description:
Target slot for an activity move; `chapter_id` reparents within the same
course, omitted keeps the current chapter.

MoveChapterRequest.description: Target slot for a chapter move; out-of-range positions clamp.

OverrideRequest.description: Full override block (create and update share it).

expires_at_unix.description: After this the override is ignored.

logo_key.description: Public-bucket storage keys (served via the CDN /content route).

Policy.description:
The complete policy block. Replaced wholesale via `PUT`; the same shape
is returned on every assessment read. Ranges are validated server-side
(422 with field errors).

attempt_penalty_percent.description: Max-score cap per extra attempt (0 = off).

Problem.description: The wire shape of every error response.

code.description: Stable machine code — the frontend's i18n key.

details.description:
Machine-readable context for some codes (e.g. `{expected, actual}`
on an optimistic-lock 409).

request_id.description: Correlation id; also present as the `x-request-id` response header.

type.description: Stable documentation URI for this error class.

QaForwardedProps.description: What this API reads from AG-UI `forwardedProps`.

oneOf.description: Narrow the context to one activity of the course.

client_turn_id.description: Client turn id: a retry with the same id replays the stored answer.

oneOf.description: Continue an existing thread of the caller in this course.

QaWireMessage.description: One message of the AG-UI conversation the client sends back.

ReadinessIssue.description: One thing blocking (or advising against) publication.

severity.description: `blocker` | `warning` | `advice` — every current rule is a blocker.

ReferenceCheck.description: One language's verdict from the author's reference check.

status.description: Run status, or `missing_solution` when no reference exists.

ReleaseState.description: What the learner may see of a grade (legacy `release_state`).

items.description:
Item ids in the desired order; omitted items follow in their
current order.

version.description: Teacher optimistic lock (`If-Match` on grade saves).

display_name_key.description: i18n key (frontend catalogs own the display strings).

RunRequest.description: Run source against an item's visible tests, or against one custom input.

custom_input.description: When present the run is unscored: one case named `custom`.

RunStatus.description: One AI run as its owner sees it (legacy `AIRunStatusRead`).

RunStreamRequest.description: AG-UI `RunAgentInput` correlation ids echoed back in every `RUN_*` event.

SaveDraftRequest.description: Partial answers; items not mentioned keep their current answer.

SaveViewRequest.description: Save (or overwrite by name + type) a dashboard view.

ScanStatus.description:
Malware-scan status of an attached file (scanning itself is a later
slice; everything is `pending` until then).

SessionInfo.description:
The current session, as the frontend sees it (client-side permission
gating mirrors the legacy `Session` contract).

SessionSummary.description:
One of the caller's live sessions. `handle` is a non-bearer identifier
(raw session ids never leave the server).

user_ids.description: Direct allowlist (restricted mode); each must already have course access.

usergroup_ids.description: Group allowlist (restricted mode); each must be linked to the course.

permissions.description:
Full replacement grant set; every entry must parse against the
permission registry (`resource:action[:scope]`).

disabled.description: `true` disables the account and revokes every live session.

pass_rate.description: Percent of graded work at or above the passing score.

StudentSubmission.description:
One attempt as its owner sees it. Scores, grading and lateness penalty
are `null` until the grade is released.

draft_version.description: Send back as `If-Match` on draft saves and submits.

time_remaining_seconds.description: Seconds left on an open timed draft; `null` when untimed or closed.

answers.description: A last patch applied before grading.

violation_count.description: The client's anti-cheat count; the server's own count wins when higher.

TeacherSubmission.description: A submission as the grader sees it — nothing redacted.

version.description: Send back as `If-Match` on grade saves.

TotpEnrollment.description: TOTP enrollment secrets — shown to the user exactly once.

Trail.description: The caller's trail. `id` is `null` until something was added.

TrailRunStatus.description: Trail run status (legacy `StatusEnum`; only `in_progress` is written today).

courses.description: Replaces the whole membership when present (legacy semantics).

oneOf.description: Replaces the whole metadata block when present.

logo_upload_id.description: Finalized `platform-logo` upload to claim as the new logo.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Partial update; omitted fields are unchanged.

avatar_upload_id.description: Finalized `avatar` upload to claim as the new avatar.

UsageSummary.description:
Platform usage against the monthly budget (legacy `AIUsageSummary`)
plus the month's heaviest users.

WorkItem.description:
One thing to act on.

`id` is stable across calls; `kind` names the situation (`in_progress`, `overdue`, `waiting_for_grade`,
`returned_for_revision`, `feedback_released`, `needs_grading`,
`sla_breach`, `awaiting_release`).

href.description: Client route for the primary action.

WorkQueue.description: One page; `total` counts the whole queue before paging.

WorkState.description: Product-level work state shown to the learner.
